name: Chou Kagaku Dasshutsu Story ~Zekkai no Gouka Kyakusen~
original_name: 超科学脱出ストーリー ～絶海の豪華客船～
source:
Hitomi Akeneno is a 16 year old high school student with a little secret - she has not one, but two psychic powers.

After receiving an invitation, she boards a luxury cruise ship with her friend, Chisono Shio. As soon as she enters a suite room, a loud explosion sounds…and she finds herself stuck, unable to get out. Is this an accident? Or something far more sinister…?

The only way to find out is to escape, with the help of her powers.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/parascientific-escape-cruise-in-the-distant-seas-3ds]Nintendo[/url]]
translation:
明野瞳 (Hitomi Akeneno) 是一名16岁的高中生，她有一个小秘密 - 她拥有的不是一种，而是两种超能力。

收到邀请后，她与朋友盐千园登上了豪华游轮。当她进入套房时，一声巨大的爆炸声响起……她发现自己被困住了，无法出去。这是意外吗？还是更险恶的事情……？

找到答案的唯一方法就是借助她的力量逃跑。

[来自[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/parascientific-escape-cruise-in-the-distant-seas-3ds]任天堂[/url]]
